def.zh-tw: 自然科學探究與實作的四個探究面向之一，包含觀察現象、蒐集資訊、形成或訂定問題、提出可驗證的觀點。各面向沒有固定的先後順序，可以循環進行。
def.en: One of the four inquiry strands of 自然科學探究與實作: observing phenomena, gathering information, framing or defining questions, and proposing testable claims. The strands have no fixed order and can be done in cycles.

source.locator: 108課綱 自然領綱 自然科學探究與實作 探究學習內容

def.zh-tw: 自然科學探究與實作的四個探究面向之一，包含尋找變因或條件、擬定研究計畫、收集資料數據。各面向沒有固定的先後順序，可以循環進行。
def.en: One of the four inquiry strands of 自然科學探究與實作: finding variables or conditions, drafting a research plan, and collecting data. The strands have no fixed order and can be done in cycles.

source.locator: 108課綱 自然領綱 自然科學探究與實作 探究學習內容

def.zh-tw: 探究實驗中刻意改變的量，要寫成可以測量的物理量。國中課綱稱為自變項。
def.en: The quantity you deliberately change in an investigation, written as a measurable physical quantity. Junior-high curriculum content calls it the 自變項 (independent variable).

source.locator: 113學測 自然 非選擇題評分原則 第43題

def.zh-tw: 因為操縱變因改變而跟著改變、在實驗中被測量的量，要寫成可以測量的物理量。國中課綱稱為應變項。
def.en: The quantity that changes because the manipulated variable changes, and is measured in the investigation; it is written as a measurable physical quantity. Junior-high curriculum content calls it the 應變項 (dependent variable).

source.locator: 113學測 自然 非選擇題評分原則 第43題

def.zh-tw: 可能影響實驗結果、所以在每一組都保持相同的量。保持相同，比較的差別才能歸因於操縱變因。
def.en: A quantity that might affect the result and is therefore kept the same in every run, so that any difference can be put down to the manipulated variable.

source.locator: 自然科學探究與實作 規劃與研究
